subject: ISV harmony check — ForgeWare SDK compatibility
messages:
From: Ari Kaplan <ari.kaplan@forgeware.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: ISV compatibility review & certification — ForgeWare SDK

Hi Marissa / Vanessa,

Thanks for taking a look — I lead Partnerships at ForgeWare AI. Were preparing an ISV certification for a joint runtime/plugin that integrates our SDK with LangChain and LlamaIndex flows and want Redwoods compatibility stamp for your hosted and dedicated runtimes.

Attached is an early compatibility matrix (compat-matrix-v1.xlsx) showing current SDK surface area, supported transports, and trace hooks. High-level asks:
- A short intake call this week to align on mutual action plan
- A checklist of Redwood requirements for SDK certification (security artifacts, telemetry contract, test harness)
- Guidance on any code changes for tracer semantics + recommended image/quantization profiles for Dedicated stacks

Were flexible on timeline but ideally would run a 2-week pilot in July. Devon from PromptSmith (ccd) is our integration lead and can share sample traces/mocks.

Attachments: compat-matrix-v1.xlsx (stub)

Thanks,
Ari Kaplan
Head of Partnerships, ForgeWare AI
ari.kaplan@forgeware.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192

Subject: Re: Request: ISV compatibility review & certification — ForgeWare SDK

Ari  thanks for the write-up and the matrix — received.

Quick next steps from Redwood:
1) Intake call: proposing Wed 23 Jun 10:00 PT / 13:00 ET (30m). Vanessa (partner lead) + Jonas (runtime eng) will join.
2) Intake deliverables: can you share a short README for the SDK + a sandbox service endpoint (write or read-only) so our infra team can run basic handshake tests?
3) Certification checklist: Im attaching our lightweight ISV intake checklist (internal template) and will follow up with a formal SOW if the pilot scope looks good.

Well also want to map the trace hooks to our tracing contract (span naming, attributes). Jonas, can you scan the attached matrix ahead of the call?

Attachment: redwood-isv-intake-checklist.pdf (internal stub)

Thanks — looking forward to the call.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of ISV Partnerships | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Ari Kaplan <ari.kaplan@forgeware.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: ISV compatibility review & certification — ForgeWare SDK

Thanks Ari — good to meet you (virtually) earlier on the call. Following up with a few technical notes and acceptance criteria that will shape the pilot:

- Tracing contract: Redwood requires a top-level span that includes request_id, model_variant, token_count and a tokenization_score attribute if you expose tokenization latency. We prefer OTEL-compatible spans.
- Runtime variants: For Hosted API compatibility we need a black-boxed container image + HTTP health endpoints. For Redwood Dedicated, the SDK should support a small KV cache handshake to validate prefix cache reuse.
- Security artifacts: SOC2-packaged evidence or a short attestation for data handling and retention. If SOC2 is not available, a security questionnaire + an ASM key rotation plan will suffice for pilot.

Please mark the items above in your matrix. Also: can you provide a test account + ephemeral API key for the sandbox (read-only) and a minimal corpus we can run through both LangChain extractor and a LlamaIndex index flow? That will let our runtime team exercise batching and KV cache semantics.

Jonas: Ive flagged two ops items for you in the matrix (span mapping and cache handshake). Priyom, once they return artifacts well route through our ISV cert queue and estimate a 2-3 week technical review.

Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Partner Engineering | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai

Appreciate the detailed checklist and Vanessas notes — super helpful. Quick updates:

- Sandbox: weve spun up an ephemeral sandbox (read-only) and created an API key for your runtime team. Sandbox access: https://drive.google.com/example-sandbox-access (temporary credentials will be shared with Jonas via secure channel).
- Artifacts: Devon will drop a small sample corpus and example trace bundle into the sandbox folder by EOD.
- Docs/Next steps: Were good to start technical review on Monday; if Redwood can confirm the reviewer list (ops + security + runtime), well queue 2-week pilot kickoff.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/sign/abc123-example (partner PSA)

Thanks — calling out Devon to confirm sample artifacts.

Best,
